title: Turing Patterns
description: A zebra's stripes, a leopard's spots, the ridges of a fingerprint: the same two-chemical sum at different spacings. Unlocks cheaper Turing Morphogens and Morphogenic Serum.

puzzle.goal: A tail of radius R has bands laid round it at a spacing w. Write how many bands N fit along its circumference.
puzzle.name: Zebra count
puzzle.ask: Find N for R = @{R} and w = @{w}.
puzzle.method: The way round is 2πR; a pattern of spacing w repeats every w along it.
